composition_subtypes.role: Find connected components via union-find to enable swaps.
Greedy assign smallest values to earliest indices via sorting.

payload.core_composition_summary: Union-find to find components, then assign sorted values to sorted indices per component for lexicographically smallest permutation.
payload.rationale: Union-find determines swappable components. Greedy assignment of sorted values to sorted indices per component achieves lexicographically smallest permutation.
